exposure: Women who exceeded Institute of Medicine (IOM) guidelines for gestational weight gain
Women who lost at least 75% of gestational weight gain
outcome: Postpartum weight loss (at least 75% of gestational weight gain)
cohort: 75 women with recent gestational diabetes mellitus
finding: Less gestational weight gain, increased age, and lack of insulin use during pregnancy were significantly associated with at least 75% postpartum weight loss by early postpartum in women with recent GDM.
